prior_exposure: All periods previously viewed; fixed descriptive study without pristine holdout or later optimization
direction: Strict 2left/2right pivots; close break of pivots known before current bar closes; update direction then register new pivots; equal extremes rejected; simultaneous up/down break sets zero; zero initialization not reversal
h1_agreement: H1 pivot direction plus strict close-vs-EMA25 side plus strict EMA25 slope in same direction; H4 recorded only
ema: SMA25 seed from first 25 complete observed closes then alpha2/26 on complete bars only; preserve EMA value across gaps without synthetic updates; cross and H1 slope require adjacent complete contiguous bars
scenario: M15 -d to d at close while H1 agrees; subsequent M5 -d to d must close strictly later. H1 disagreement/M15 direction unequal including zero/gap loses scenario until new M15 reversal
episode: Fix latest known M15 opposite pivot plus 1tick outward SL at M5 reversal; creation bar must not touch stop. If reversal bar has true directional EMA cross, count phase1 (video 15:31-15:40). Otherwise phase0 even if already on directional side. Reverse and final forward crosses require separate later bars. Strict <=to> / >=to< crossings.
cancel: H1/M15/M5 direction unequal to episode direction (including zero)/SL touch/frame gap/or age>96; no same-bar rearm after cancellation
gap_state: Each frame clears only pivot rolling window on invalid or discontinuous bar, retaining known pivots/direction/EMA; M5/M15/H1 gaps clear scenario and episode; no trigger on discontinuity; H4 only diagnostic
signal_use: Each episode each arm once; per symbol arm RR one open trade; ignore signals while position open; exit-bar-close signal may enter next open
execution: Signal complete known bar; next contiguous M5 entry requires starts_at_open only, never future complete flag. Risk>0. Actual-entry RR full exit, adverse observed-open gap/favorable cap TP, SL first. Process OHLC hits on incomplete bar; otherwise schedule gap liquidation for next actual observed open. Time exit at 48th complete held bar close, or queue next actual open if incomplete. At period/data end without next executable observation use OPEN_MARK at last observed close, exclude from closed-trade win rate/PF, disclose separately. No historical rewind. Held position with starts_at_open false exits at first observed open after stop/TP gap priority. Annual classification uses actual open time unchanged, bar-close/intrabar labels minus 1second.
phase_boundary: Reset scenarios/episodes/positions at phase start; indicators warmup; continuous account generated separately with no phase resets
cost_limits: Fixed round-trip friction deducted once; no bid/ask replay, broker-specific commissions or swap. No old FXSpace cost/risk filter or daily clear

account.stop_rule: Deduct entire round-trip cost at entry; riskbudget=min(.005equity,equity-900000); floor price from fixed quantity/equity, tighter of strategy SL and floor stop; floor-trigger or gap-through floor stops account permanently. Gap can overshoot. Account exit path separate from R-study execution.

gate.pass_meaning: Research criteria only; no adoption approval
gate.zero_loss_pf: profits>0 losses0 -> positive infinity for comparisons; JSON PF null with pf_infinite true. Zero trades never passes.

output: Signal arrays, trades CSV, annual/phase/symbol/pooled stats including zero trades, Wilson95, PF, meanR, realized win/loss size ratio, closed cumulativeR maxDD, continuous account, input/output/code SHA, UTC start/end, no overwrite
